# Depth-2 assignment where the range value variable is a multiplier must not be hoisted as a broadcast scalar; behavior stays identical with and without simd.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Mix(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i, v := range b {
		dst[i] = a[i]*v + b[i]
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := make([]float32, 4)
	a := []float32{1, 2, 3, 4}
	b := []float32{10, 20, 30, 40}
	test.Mix(dst, a, b)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3])
}
-- testmain/output --
20 60 120 200
